mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse (whCode, whName, whAddress, whTelephone, whField, whTotalCapa, whGrade, whUseCapa) VALUES (#{whCode}, #{whName}, #{whAddress}, #{whTelephone}, #{whField}, #{whTotalCapa}, #{whGrade}, #{whUseCapa})

choose.when: SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX(whAddress, ' ', 2) AS whAddress FROM warehouse
choose.otherwise: SELECT whCode, whName, whGrade, whAddress FROM warehouse
